wordsprout_decision.note: WordSprout uses the public curriculum scope and progression level as a reference. Grade placement, word order, Chinese glosses, distractors and exercises are independently authored and are not an official per-grade allocation or a textbook synchronization claim.

rights_note: The source PDF is linked for verification rather than mirrored. Individual common English words and curriculum structure are factual educational references; the app does not copy textbook passages, exercises, artwork, recordings or a publisher's sequence.
maintenance: Recheck the public source and curriculum wording whenever the vocabulary model changes. Do not relabel the 600-word collection as an official 600-word national list.
